edges.reason: Staked amount parameter is added to the internal balances and total supply.
Untrusted msg.sender determines which balance is credited during stake.
stake increases _totalSupply by the staked amount.
stake increases the caller's entry in _balances.
stake performs an external LP safeTransferFrom after mutating internal balances.
Withdraw amount parameter is subtracted from balances and total supply.
Untrusted msg.sender determines which balance is debited during withdraw.
withdraw decreases _totalSupply by the withdrawn amount.
withdraw decreases the caller's entry in _balances.
withdraw performs an external LP safeTransfer to the untrusted caller.
Overridden pool stake delegates to super.stake in LPTokenWrapper.
updateReward modifier refreshes rewardPerTokenStored via rewardPerToken.
checkStart modifier gates stake on block.timestamp >= starttime.
Pool stake consumes the amount parameter before calling super.stake.
Overridden pool withdraw delegates to super.withdraw in LPTokenWrapper.
updateReward modifier refreshes reward accounting via rewardPerToken.
checkStart modifier gates withdraw on block.timestamp >= starttime.
Pool withdraw consumes the amount parameter.
exit calls withdraw with the caller's full balance.
exit calls getReward to claim accrued rewards.
exit derives the withdrawal amount from balanceOf(msg.sender).
getReward reads and pays rewards for untrusted msg.sender.
getReward reads and zeroes the caller's entry in the rewards mapping.
getReward makes an external call to YUAN.yuansScalingFactor() on an untrusted token contract.
getReward transfers YUAN tokens to the caller via an external safeTransfer call.
The external scaling factor call result feeds the local scalingFactor variable.
Local reward value is read from the rewards mapping inside getReward.
Local scalingFactor is used to compute the transferred reward amount.
trueReward is the scaled amount passed to yuan.safeTransfer.
rewardPerToken divides by totalSupply to derive per-token accrual.
rewardPerToken accumulates into rewardPerTokenStored.
rewardPerToken calls getrewardPerTokenAmount whose arithmetic defines the emitted rate.
earned multiplies the user's staked balance from _balances.
earned calls rewardPerToken to compute the accrual delta.
earned subtracts userRewardPerTokenPaid from the current rate.
earned adds previously stored rewards for the account.
Account parameter selects the user whose reward is computed.
lastTimeRewardApplicable depends directly on block.timestamp.
lastTimeRewardApplicable caps the timestamp with periodFinish.
getrewardPerTokenAmount caches the applicable timestamp locally.
getrewardPerTokenAmount caches distributionTime locally.
getrewardPerTokenAmount caches lastUpdateTime locally.
Local offset is computed with modulo over halveInterval.
Local first interval end derives from the offset and halveInterval.
Accumulated per-token amount is built by chained multiply/add operations.
Current reward rate is derived from getFixedRewardRate at the evaluated timestamp.
getrewardPerTokenAmount performs modulo, subtraction and left-shift arithmetic.
getrewardPerTokenAmount repeatedly calls getFixedRewardRate.
getrewardPerTokenAmount reads lastUpdateTime for interval boundaries.
getrewardPerTokenAmount reads distributionTime for interval boundaries.
rewardRate delegates to getFixedRewardRate(block.timestamp).
rewardRate is fully determined by the untrusted block.timestamp.
getFixedRewardRate applies a right shift to initialRewardRate that can silently truncate.
getFixedRewardRate reads initialRewardRate as the base rate.
getFixedRewardRate caps the timestamp with periodFinish.
getFixedRewardRate offsets by distributionTime before dividing.
Timestamp parameter drives the halving interval computation.
getFixedRewardRate divides elapsed time by halveInterval.
onlyRewardDistribution restricts notifyRewardAmount to the rewardDistribution address.
notifyRewardAmount writes lastUpdateTime.
notifyRewardAmount writes distributionTime.
notifyRewardAmount writes periodFinish.
notifyRewardAmount writes initialRewardRate.
notifyRewardAmount branches on block.timestamp versus starttime and periodFinish.
Reward parameter is validated and converted into the initial reward rate.
Computed _firstReward is divided by halveInterval into initialRewardRate.
notifyRewardAmount uses DURATION to set periodFinish.
setRewardDistribution is onlyOwner and rewrites the privileged rewardDistribution address.
New reward distribution address parameter is stored into rewardDistribution.
balanceOf returns the account entry from _balances.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state value.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter amount only carries the staked value into the pool stake function.
Parameter amount only carries the withdrawal value into the pool withdraw function.
Local cached reward is only meaningful inside getReward.
Local scaling factor is produced and consumed inside getReward.
Local trueReward is only used to size the transfer in getReward.
Parameter account only selects the user inside the earned view function.
Timestamp parameter is only consumed by getFixedRewardRate.
Parameter reward is only consumed by notifyRewardAmount.
Local _firstReward is only used to derive initialRewardRate in notifyRewardAmount.
Parameter only assigns the rewardDistribution state variable in the setter.
Local cached timestamp is only used within getrewardPerTokenAmount.
Local distributionTime copy is only used within getrewardPerTokenAmount.
Local lastUpdateTime copy is only used within getrewardPerTokenAmount.
Local offset is only used within getrewardPerTokenAmount.
Local interval boundary is only used within getrewardPerTokenAmount.
Accumulator local is only used within getrewardPerTokenAmount.
Local current rate is only used within getrewardPerTokenAmount.
